Retain magenta/cyan/amber sprite colors exactly; no green illumination or glow. Four meaningful evolving frames of SAME motif: birth/brighten, rotate/expand, peak/compress, settle/return. Fixed cell center anchor. ROW 2, weapon B: compact magenta refracted crystal shard, from left side magenta optical-port cannon. Visibly small compact, approximate extent 21% cell width and 21% cell height. Four meaningful evolving frames of SAME motif: birth/brighten, rotate/expand, peak/compress, settle/return. Fixed cell center anchor. ROW 3, weapon C: wide amber-cyan concentric light pulse, from upper pivoting gold lens emitter. Visibly broad wide, approximate extent 38% cell width and 28% cell height. Four meaningful evolving frames of SAME motif: birth/brighten, rotate/expand, peak/compress, settle/return. Fixed cell center anchor. ROW 4, weapon heavy: large cyan-magenta prismatic energy torpedo, from overcharged prism aperture. Visibly large heavy, approximate extent 44% cell width and 34% cell height. Four meaningful evolving frames of SAME motif: birth/brighten, rotate/expand, peak/compress, settle/return. Fixed cell center anchor. The corresponding boss weapon A/B/C muzzle birth must match that row colors, shape and material. No translation across cells. Different projectile sizes are artwork fitted to existing game hazard bounds; keep original timing, speed, paths, damage and count.
